links.outcome: Ethical violations and risk level of LLM responses after iterative automated evaluator-agent review
links.effect: Iterative multi-agent loop achieved an 89% reduction in ethical violations and a 92% risk downgrade rate across 900 queries.
links.quote: The iterative multi-agent loop achieved an 89% reduction in ethical violations and a 92% risk downgrade rate, underscoring the effectiveness of our approach.

unlisted_practices: Iterative multi-agent LLM evaluator-generator refinement loop scoring responses against AMA Principles of Medical Ethics and a five-tier safety risk assessment

screen.reason: The study empirically tests a multi-agent evaluation and refinement guardrail loop added to LLMs to detect and mitigate ethical violations and safety risks across medical queries.

primary.practice: multi-agent iterative evaluation and guardrail loop
